code:
import os
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUTDIR=os.getcwd(); print("writing provenance tables to",OUTDIR)

# ---------- Table 1: active-site mapping (values computed in iterations 1-3) ----------
t1=pd.DataFrame([
 ["Glu144 (base, activates catalytic water)","Glu158",0.29,"E","present","98","OE2 2.85 A to C3'; 2.86 A in re-run"],
 ["Glu164 (acid, protonates C2)","Asn178",1.98,"N","ABSENT","92","no carboxylate; nearest acid O 5.04 A from C2'"],
 ["Gly141 (oxyanion hole NH)","Asn155",0.63,"N","backbone NH kept",'96',"N 2.58 A to O1' (rat 2.64); side-chain OD1 0.50 A from O1'"],
 ["Ala98 (oxyanion hole NH)","Phe108",1.10,"F","backbone NH displaced","93","N 4.05 A to O1' (rat 3.28)"],
 ["Gly142","Gly156",0.0,"G","present","97","conserved Gly in 65/66 orthologs"],
 ["Ala173","Asp187",None,"D","extra acid","95","5.04 A from C2', 3.94 A from C3'; beta face"],
],columns=["rat_ECH_position_2DUB","Srlp_residue","CA_CA_dist_A","Srlp_aa","status","pLDDT","measurement"])
t1.to_csv(f"{OUTDIR}/table1_active_site_mapping.csv",index=False)

# ---------- Table 2: crotonase panel, occupancy of the two catalytic positions ----------
t2=pd.DataFrame([
 ["2DUB","rat enoyl-CoA hydratase","Glu144","Glu164",254,0.0,"hydratase","both acids"],
 ["1HZD","human AUH methylglutaconyl-CoA hydratase","Glu189","Glu209",230,1.50,"hydratase","both acids"],
 ["1DCI","rat d3,5-d2,4-dienoyl-CoA isomerase","Asp176","Glu196",221,1.42,"isomerase","both acids"],
 ["1SG4","rat d3,d2-enoyl-CoA isomerase","Gly111","(Glu136 maps near rat 171)",131,2.25,"isomerase","acid side only"],
 ["AF-Q9VG69","Drosophila Srlp","Glu158","Asn178",142,2.20,"unknown","BASE SIDE ONLY"],
],columns=["pdb","protein","residue_at_rat144","residue_at_rat164","CA_pairs","RMSD_A","reaction_class","carboxylate_pattern"])
t2.to_csv(f"{OUTDIR}/table2_crotonase_panel.csv",index=False)

# ---------- Table 3: published mutagenesis effect sizes at the two positions ----------
t3=pd.DataFrame([
 ["rat mECH-1 (crotonase)","Glu144Ala","144","hydration",2000,"10074351"],
 ["rat mECH-1 (crotonase)","Glu164Ala","164","hydration",2000,"10074351"],
 ["rat mECH-1 (crotonase)","Glu144Ala","144","isomerization",10,"10074351"],
 ["rat mECH-1 (crotonase)","Glu164Ala","164","isomerization",1000,"10074351"],
 ["rat dienoyl-CoA isomerase","Asp176Ala","144-equivalent","isomerization",10,"11278886"],
 ["rat dienoyl-CoA isomerase","Glu196Gln","164-equivalent","isomerization",100000,"11278886"],
],columns=["enzyme","variant","position_class","reaction","fold_kcat_loss","pmid"])
t3.to_csv(f"{OUTDIR}/table3_published_mutagenesis.csv",index=False)
for n,t in [("table1",t1),("table2",t2),("table3",t3)]:
    print("\n==",n,"=="); print(t.to_string(index=False))

# ---------- figure ----------
fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,5.0))
ax=fig.add_subplot(1,3,1)
labs=["rat Glu164\nto C2'","Srlp Glu158\nto C2'","Srlp Asp187\nto C2'"]; vals=[3.40,4.17,5.04]
ax.bar(labs,vals,color=["#2c7a3f","#b03030","#b03030"],width=.6)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+.1,f"{v:.2f}",ha="center",fontsize=10)
ax.axhline(3.5,ls="--",c="#555",lw=1); ax.text(2.45,3.62,"proton-transfer limit",ha="right",fontsize=8,color="#555")
ax.set_ylabel("distance to alpha carbon C2', A"); ax.set_ylim(0,6.2)
ax.set_title("A. No Srlp carboxylate reaches C2'",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(1,3,2)
names=["2DUB\nECH","1HZD\nAUH","1DCI\nDCI","1SG4\nECI","Srlp"]
has144=[1,1,1,0,1]; has164=[1,1,1,1,0]
x=np.arange(5)
ax.bar(x-.19,has144,.36,label="acid at rat 144 (base site)",color="#4878a8")
ax.bar(x+.19,has164,.36,label="acid at rat 164 (acid site)",color="#c05a1e")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(names,fontsize=8.5); ax.set_yticks([0,1]); ax.set_yticklabels(["absent","present"])
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5,loc="lower left"); ax.set_ylim(0,1.45)
ax.annotate("only member lacking\nthe 164 acid",xy=(4.19,.05),xytext=(3.0,1.15),fontsize=8,color="#a01010",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->",color="#a01010"))
ax.set_title("B. Srlp is the only panel member\nwithout the 164-site acid",fontsize=10)

ax=fig.add_subplot(1,3,3)
cats=["hydration\nE144A","hydration\nE164A","isomerization\nE144A","isomerization\nE164A"]
folds=[2000,2000,10,1000]; cc=["#4878a8","#c05a1e","#4878a8","#c05a1e"]
ax.bar(cats,folds,color=cc,width=.62); ax.set_yscale("log")
for i,v in enumerate(folds): ax.text(i,v*1.25,f"{v}x",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("fold decrease in kcat (log)"); ax.set_ylim(1,2e4)
ax.set_xticklabels(cats,fontsize=8)
ax.set_title("C. Rat crotonase mutagenesis, PMID 10074351\nGlu164 is required for both reactions",fontsize=9.5)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
